description: This file contains implementation of JSON serialization functions for scheduler metrics and events, as well as functions to generate JSON reports for scheduler metrics in a 3GPP LTE/NR context.

classes.name: scheduler_cell_event
classes.description: Represents a scheduler cell event with a type, slot, and RNTI.

classes.name: scheduler_ue_metrics
classes.description: Contains metrics related to a user equipment (UE) in the scheduler.

classes.name: scheduler_cell_metrics
classes.description: Holds metrics for a scheduler cell, including error counts, latency, and resource usage.

classes.name: scheduler_metrics_report
classes.description: Aggregates the metrics report for the scheduler, including cell metrics and timestamp.

methods.name: event_to_string
methods.description: Converts a scheduler cell event type to its string representation.

methods.name: to_json (scheduler_cell_event)
methods.description: Serializes a scheduler cell event to JSON.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a JSON object representing the scheduler metrics report.

methods.name: generate_string
methods.description: Returns a pretty-printed JSON string of the scheduler metrics report.
